statements.quote: Before the formal experiment began, all participants received detailed written and verbal instructions outlining the game objectives, gameplay rules, and expected writing tasks. statements.locator: p. 14, Section 4.1, instructions and practice; markdown line 325.

statements.quote: With participants’ informed consent, all gaming sessions and interviews were audio and video recorded. The researchers also took observational notes of participants’ interactions, decisionmaking behaviors, and writing activities, which were cross-referenced with the audio and video recordings for subsequent analysis. Immediately after each gaming session, participants were asked to complete a post-experiment questionnaire assessing their creativity support index, creative self-efficacy, and story satisfaction. Each group also participated in a semi-structured interview to reflect on their experiences with the collaborative writing process. All data were anonymized and transcribed for qualitative and comparative analysis.

notes:
Checked on 2026-10-10. Read all 1,412 lines of the 51-page markdown conversion, including References and Appendices A-H. Verified key release statements with PyMuPDF text extraction from PDF pp. 12 and 51 and the demographic-information statement on p. 42. Quotes are copied directly from the markdown, retaining its wording and footnote formatting; each gives the PDF page and markdown line. The PDF contains no embedded files.

The sole named external FIERO data/code/materials repository is GitHub, cited in Section 3.4 footnote 11 and Appendix H and repeated in the form. No preregistration, on-request data statement, separate statistical supplement, or other study deposit URL was found in the complete paper. Appendix H is titled Reproducibility Artifact and Data Release, but its text specifies system code, cards, and prompts rather than participant outcome data. The later repository README explicitly describes study data as a future OSF release.

The paper itself contains aggregate questionnaire results in Appendix A, questionnaire and interview materials, participant-facing scripts, evaluator and system prompts, demographic rosters with group/participant IDs in Appendix C, and selected story/interview excerpts in the results. The demographic rosters and illustrative excerpts are not a released outcome dataset: they do not identify the analyzed story subset, provide questionnaire response rows, or supply complete stories and pairwise judgments linked to teams and participants. The paper is therefore not counted as a separate data deposit.

No public file permits computation of the missing final.open_items statistics: analyzed people represented by the nine scored texts per arm and exclusions; uncertainty accounting for repeated story use; reconciliation of Overall versus Final_Winner; or questionnaire item denominators and processing. There are no linked participant outcomes from which to reconstruct person-level means, SDs, or SEs, and no complete arm-labelled story corpus from which to estimate diversity. Allocation implementation and timing of team formation also remain unverified.

Search result counts are API totals, not counts of relevant datasets. The relevant arrays contain matching paper records where applicable; these are not data deposits. DataCite's exact-title result was only DOI 10.48550/arxiv.2607.11837 (Preprint), whose related identifier is the publication DOI, not a dataset. Reviewed all 478 broad first-author results across five pages, all 102 FIERO results across two pages, and all 72 author-filtered Dataset results. No additional FIERO deposit was identified. Zenodo results for FIERO (13) and both author spellings (1 and 34; the latter over two pages) concern other works; Harvard Dataverse returned zero for each query.

Ambiguous author-search matches were checked through repository APIs: https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/24270340 returned HTTP 200 and identifies DATA.xlsx as black-carbon/PAH data, published in 2023; https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/30795551 returned HTTP 200 and links Supporting Information to a perovskite-solar-cell paper (DOI 10.1063/5.0306655); https://zenodo.org/api/records/11337997 returned HTTP 200 and identifies CrossReality as a 2024 conference performance paper. These are unrelated and are excluded from deposits.

OSF node title searches returned empty data arrays with no next page, giving confirmed counts of zero. The first-author name was additionally searched through OSF's full-name user filter: four profiles matched, only one with the exact full name Chu Zhang (nkhq2). Its public-node endpoint returned zero; identity with this paper's author is not established. This is not proof that no private or differently named project exists. No relevant OSF node was discovered, so no study-specific files/osfstorage or children endpoint could be queried.
